changes.authority: P2 Ordinary two-letter words: a lowercase two-letter word (in, or, me, ok, hi, pa, oh, ...) counts as a place only if the model's reading names that place, and never triggers a "Did you also mean" suggestion on its own. Lowercase "us"/"usa" may trigger a US suggestion only when no other place in the request is the United States; a state never counts as covering the United States. If the input is mostly capitals, treat it as lowercase for code detection. Capitalised codes in normal-case text follow the existing R2 rule. Tests: "marine capacity in World" -> no Indiana suggestion; "how much oil does japan us" -> Japan plus US suggestion; "gas in OH vs us" -> Ohio and US, no suggestion; "coal in pa" -> Pennsylvania (when the model names it); "coal OR gas in Ohio" -> no Oregon; "COAL USE IN OHIO" -> Ohio only; "coal in OR" -> Oregon.
